skills.canonAnchor: "A crafting requires a link between the two entities, normally this would be an arm or a blade" (L459); Gerik's whole lecture on transfer, loss over distance and many-small-over-one-big (L442-457); "Everyone has 'magic' though without training it will stay passive, but even with training it is limited" (L98); public-issue vs restricted library editions (L2472)
skills.provenance: Simple Magic pass. INVENTED NAME (canon calls the practice 'crafting', which would collide with smithing in a skill list; LoT2's academic name for the field is 'Thectrochanics'). NEEDS-BLESSING, two items: (1) that a commoner can open a BRIDGED link at all - L459 says making one takes 'the gift' and 'almost nobody can do this', and the reading that rescues Eli's premise is that the gift is needed for an UNBRIDGED link while an arm or a blade is the ordinary case; (2) the imperial edict opening the Granadad libraries to any who can read, which appears nowhere in the novel (canon has the Library of the Runemasters in MERCIA, L2478, and a monastery library in the Divine Light Cathedral, L2412). WIT governs because the gate is READING. Deliberately absent from every section-5 AttributeWeights row - zero attribute drift by construction.
